book.title: Lijambu la Amboni ngati ejuandiki Luka

content: Mahakau
Ndienu Yesu jaapwagila banafunzi baki, “Sakaka ipitila hindu yeyunkolo mundu kutenda mahakau, lakini musijikiboni mundu jojaakoloha mahakau gapitila!
Kwiibia mbanga kwaka mundu hoju kunkongale lilibu likolongu lukupole pahingujaki nukundeke gunhanga, kuliku kunhenga jumwa jwa asoku haba jutenda mmahakau.
Henu mulilenda! “Nndongu waku najukukosi, nndakalya, najombi najujetaki mahakau gaki jijeleka kabee, gundekakiya.
Ana jukosi mala saba ku lisoba limu, najukelabwiki kwaku kabee mala saba sukupwaga, ‘Nyetaki mahakau nganijeleki kabee,’ Gupalika gundekakiya.”
Kuobale
Atumi baki bumpwagila Bambu, “Utujonzukya kuhobale.”
Bambu japwaaga, “Ana kuhobale kwinu kwakabia kusoku hata ngati imbeju ja haladali, mwakawesa kugupwagi nkoju ago, ‘Tupuka ukalipanda ku nhanga!’ Nagwombi wiitenda kunzoane.
Lihengu laku ntumisi
“Tupwaga jumwa kati jinu jubi nu ntumisi waki jojulema litui au julima makondoo. Boo, ntumisi jola hejuhika kuhuma ku nngonda, bambu waki ampwagila lee, ‘Guhika nyata gu kula poso?’
Ngajupwagiela! Jwiipwaga, ‘Ndelakiya posu, utumbuliya kundumaki nepani mbaka pani jomula kula na kunywa, ndi nawe wiikula na kunywa!’
Boo, jwiitenda lee kunsengu ntumisi jola ndaba juhengiki sapi gaandagalakile?
Nanamu ahelahela na nhengiti gajundagalaki Sapanga, mpwaga, ‘Twepani twa atumisi twanga na faida, tuhengiki sewalagalaki tuhenga.’ ”
Yesu jaalamisa bandu komi
Yesu pajabii mwindela kujenda ku Yelusalemu jwapetii mu mipaka juku Samalia nuku Galilaya.
Pajajingala mu kijiji simu, baketangini na bandu komi baa leliki, bajemiki sukutali,
bajamalya kwa sauti, “Yesu! Bambu! Utubonila ikia!”
Yesu ejaabona jaapwagila, “Nzendannya mukililangia kwaka agolu.” Pababi mwiindela bakajendaninya batenda kunyambisika.
Jumu wabu ejabona julamiki, jakelabukya kwaka Yesu, koni andumbali Sapanga suku jamalii.
Jililekala pai kulongi ja magolu gaka Yesu koni akunsengula. Mundu we hoju jabii juku Samalia.
Yesu jalalukya, “Boo, ngase mwalamiki lee mwa bandu kome? Boo bangi tisa bala abi kwako?
Boo, nga lee jongi jojukelabwiki ku ndumbali Sapanga ila nngeni jonzo pena?”
Ndienu Yesu ampwagila mundu jola, “Jumuka gujenda, kuhobale kwaku kugulamise.”
Eguhika ubambu Ukolongu waka Sapanga
Lisoba limu Afalisayu bundalukiya Yesu, “Ukolongu waka Sapanga wiika lii?” Najombi jaapwagila, “Ukolongu waka Sapanga ngaguhiki sukubonikana kwa miho.
Ngamundu jojwiwesa kupwaaga, ‘Gubii pamba,’ au ‘Gubi kolakola.’ Ndaba Ukolongu waka Sapanga gubii nkati jino.”
Ndienu jaapwagila Banafunzi baki, “Gihika masoba mwipala kulibona lisoba limu laka Mwana waka Mundu, lakini ngamwalibone.
Bandu bampwagila, ‘Ndingalya, jubii kolakola!’ Au ‘Jubi kongone!’ Lakini mwanganya nkoto kwaapwata.
Ndaba ngati unang'anu ukitobi, hegupiti nukumulika kunani kuhumi upandi gumu mbaka upandi gongi, ndi hejwibia Mwana waka Mundu hejiiki mmasoba gaki.
Lakini kabula ja haga jwiitumbuliya hoti kung'alika ngamaa na bandu bikibeleku senze kunkana,
ngati egabii masoba gaka Noa, ndi ekwibia ahelahe mu masoba gaka Mwana waka Mundu.

Bandu baendalya kula na kunywa, akanalomi baendalya kujuku aka mbomba na aka mbomba baendaliya kujenda ku ulomu mbaka lisoba lejwajingala Noa munhwatu nkolongu gobugukema safina. Ndipala kikoka sa masi saika na kwaakoma boa.
Kwibia ngati ekwabia mmasoba gaka Lutu. Bandu baendalya kula na kunywa, kulomba nu kulombesa, kupanda imbeju nu kusenga.
Lakini lisoba lejaboka Lutu ku Sodoma, motu na malibu gagalipuka mwotu gahuluka pai kuhuma kunani kwaka Sapanga nakwaa kupisa boti.
Ndi hekwibia lisoba laka Mwana waka Mundu hejwiiyekuliwa.
“Mlisoba lee heli, mundu jokapi jojubi kunani jikipagaa jiihuluka kujingi mu nyumba kujuku hindu yaki. Kabee, najojubi ku lituhi jwikelabuki ku nyumba.
Nkombuka gagumpataa nhwanu waka Lutu.
Jokapi jojupala kugombo womi waki jitenda kuguhoa, na jokapi jojuhoa womi waki ndaba jangu, jiipata womi wa masoba goti.
Numpwagi, lisoba leheli hikilu bandu abeli biibia agoni kitanda simu, jumu biitenda kunzuku najongi biitenda kundeka.
Aka mbomba abeli bibia pamu apola ilebi yabu, jumu biitenda kunzuku najongi biitenda kundeka.”
Bandu abeli biibia kulitui, jumu biitenda kunzuku najongi biitenda kundeka.
Ndienu banafunzi baki bundalukya, “Bambo ganiaga giipitila kwako?” Yesu jajibua “Pakibii sindu sekiwii ndi ihegalane hijuni ikolongu yebikema tai.”
